title: AI's Real Role: Humans Building Smart Systems #shorts
description: Companies are building billion-dollar initiatives around humans doing what AI was supposed to eliminate: writing code and making judgment calls. AI integration should be core, not an afterthought. #AI #SoftwareDevelopment #TechTrends #Startup

top_comments.author: @franzbuhlmann1099
top_comments.text:
Isn’t it funny how AI can’t be trusted to make software.

But at the same time, AI is trusted to make Medicine and to perform surgery!

Somehow, I would rather trust AI to make software than to trust AI with my life!

Compared to medicine, software seems like child’s play! At least the risk involved is closer to playing!

I wonder how much longer it will be before applied logic will make AI capable of being trusted with software as well?

top_reply.author: @STARTUPHAKK_sh
top_reply.text: That contrast is wild — we’re way more nervous about a buggy app than a buggy diagnosis, even though the stakes are flipped. It probably comes down to how much testing and oversight each field requires before anything ships. Do you think software will get to that same level of trust first, or will medicine?
